name: branch-compare
description: Compare two branches before a merge (default staging into release): the commits the target is missing with what each does, the ones already cherry-picked, reverts, hotfixes only on the target to merge back; then what the merge would really change, from a trial merge: Kafka topics, groups and message classes, database migrations (Flyway, Liquibase), config keys and required keys against each environment's config, environment files, dependencies, API, conflicts, sensitive business code. Markdown report from a fixed template. Read-only.
